children: Covista entered into Amendment No. 6 to its Credit Agreement to reprice $510 million of outstanding term loans. The interest margin on the loans decreases to Term SOFR + 2.00% (from +2.25%), or to an alternate base rate + 1.00% (from +1.25%). The repriced loans carry a 1.00% soft call premium on certain repricing transactions for six months. All other material terms remain unchanged, reducing borrowing costs on existing debt.
: Amendment to Credit Agreement to reprice term loans
: Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: Reduce borrowing costs on existing debt
